subtasks.description: Discover and list all currently active NSF REU programs in AI and machine learning for undergraduates (2024-2025). Focus on identifying programs that explicitly involve undergraduate students and align with AI/ML research.

subtasks.description: For each identified FOA, investigate the eligibility criteria for undergraduate students. Determine if the requirements (e.g., degree level, GPA) align with typical REU program requirements.
subtasks.success_criteria: A detailed assessment of the eligibility criteria for each FOA, noting any potential barriers for undergraduate students.
